notes.title: v1.3.1 - Loadout, Powerups, Achievements, Bug Fixes, and General Improvements
notes.content:
Reworked the loadout system. There are now 3 tiers of powerups and after tier 1, players are unable to combine multiple powerups within the same tier.
 If your existing loadouts contain conflicting powerups, they will be automatically removed.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960197615726652/Loadout_tiers.png?width=1404&height=910
 Dynamic scroll speed should better accommodate fast typers.
 Achievements and their fun little icons (Thanks FreshFromTheGrave) have been added to the game. More to come.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198517502093/Achievements.png
 Added Siphon, Flip, and Reverse powerups.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198030954507/Siphon.png
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/981273807803256902/1131960198265831514/Reverse_and_Flip.png
 Updated scorekeeping ui.
 Updated powerup unlock levels and costs.

notes.title: v1.3.0 - Type Through Errors!
notes.content:
Added the option to type through errors. This is not default. You will need to toggle this in order for it to be active. 

Players will not be able to win if they have not fixed their typos.

With this setting enabled, the prompt will display the incorrect characters you've typed and allow you to backspace them until you return to the character you're supposed to type.

You can change this setting at any time in the Main Menu under Options -> Settings -> Type Through Errors.

notes.title: v1.2.0 - 1/6/2023
notes.content:
Added ability to enter your build specs: Keyboard, Switches, Keycaps. These will be shown on your profile card on leaderboards. You can set this up in the Main Menu under Options -> Build
 Added leaderboards. These leaderboards will consist of average WPM, Accuracy, and Character Interval. There is also a leaderboard for the fastest character interval as well and most games won.
 Character Interval is a metric I've used when developing the bots and figured it would be a nice way to gauge typing speed without worrying about variances in word length. It is the average time between each accurately typed character in the prompt.

notes.title: v1.1.2 - 12/02/2022
notes.content:
Fixed bug: Graph not displaying most recent matches properly
 Loading Screen on darker themes is now a temporary darker placeholder until we can get custom loading screens made for them.

notes.title: v1.1.1 - 12/02/2022
notes.content:
Fixed bug: Players kicked back to Main Menu when searching for Duel
 Changed Bug reporting tool keybind to F9 since F12 is Steam's screenshot keybind.
 Updated Warm Up mode to make things a bit clearer.

notes.title: v1.1.0 - 12/01/2022
notes.content:
Fixed bug: Party joins game and it forces all players but host back to main menu.
 Fixed bug: Allowing players to join lobby when its < 5 seconds from starting the match.
 Added functionality that enables us to put game modes with guaranteed game effects in rotation. We're starting with Barebones FFA. Selecting this option will guarantee the match you join has powerups disabled. Barebones FFA is available in the Main Menu when clicking the arrow next to the "Quick Match" button.


Next priority is to fix the recent game stats as it seems they're not functioning properly for new players.
